prohibited_conduct: No access-control bypass, credential theft, account takeover, or use of leaked credentials.
No scans of private, non-global, or otherwise unauthorized network destinations.
No paid or uncertain-charge provider/module, even when credentials or free credits are present.
No harassment, coercion, doxxing, or contact with subjects based solely on automated findings.
No use of collected data for decisions about employment, housing, credit, insurance, or other eligibility.
Honor provider rate limits, opt-outs, applicable terms, and data-protection/retention obligations.
